body.name: Julia Gillard's Misogyny Speech, 9 October 2012
body.summary: A heated parliamentary debate turned into one of our most influential political speeches. Australia's first female PM Julia Gillard joins political allies and opponents, journalists and eyewitnesses to reflect on that speech.

show.name: I Was Actually There
show.summary:
What if our history was told by the people who were actually there? What if this retelling came with all its unvarnished, irreverent and occasionally contradictory humanity still intact?

I Was Actually There will interview Australians who were there when our most defining and memorable events happened. What was it like to witness the miraculous rescue at the Beaconsfield Mine? Or flee the raging waters of the Boxing Day tsunami? Or wag school to meet the Beatles in their prime?

Through powerful contemporary interviews with diverse and colourful characters, the show will ask these Australians what they saw, how they reacted and how it changed them. While looking to the past, the series will reflect who we are now and examine why these moments still resonate.

body.name: Thredbo Landslide, 30 July 1997
body.summary: The 1997 Thredbo landslide was one of the first tragedies in Australia to unfold as a live media event, with reporters broadcasting from the mountain. After 54 hours, news broke that a sole survivor had been found alive.

show.name: The Palace Gambit
show.summary: Two sisters are summoned to the imperial court. The elder is a woman of peerless beauty, the younger a quick-witted charmer. Seeking only a peaceful existence, they instead find themselves the targets of deadly schemes with no escape in sight. Forging an unstoppable alliance, they win the Emperor's favor within months. But at the peak of their glory, the elder sister, carrying the imperial heir, meets a tragic end. Overnight, their favor vanishes. Now, the younger sister, Lu Jiuning, buries her hatred and, from her lowly position as a palace maid, challenges the entire harem. She maneuvers among the consorts and stands firm before the Emperor, setting her meticulous plans for revenge. This battle is not for favor, but for blood!

show.name: Sunshine Through The Rain
show.summary: This is the story of the headstrong girl Zheng Yu and the lonely boy Chen Yan Zhou. Burdened by her family's poverty, Zheng Yu must take on heavy responsibilities, while Chen Yan Zhou withdraws into himself after the death of his older brother. From school rivals, they gradually become a light in each other's lives, facing life's storms together.

show.name: The Eternal Supreme, Li Yunxiao
show.summary: Once hailed as the third-strongest expert on the Tianwu Continent, Martial Emperor Gu Feiyang found his cultivation trapped at its peak by the very laws of the world. To break through his limits, he orchestrated an audacious plan, sacrificing everything to reincarnate and begin anew. Reborn as Li Yunxiao, a fifteen-year-old heir of a powerful military family in the Kingdom of Tianshui, he finds himself caught in a storm of invasion, royal succession struggles, and political intrigue. While others fight for power and status, Li Yunxiao sees the bigger picture. Armed with the wisdom and experience of a former Martial Emperor, he calmly overcomes every obstacle on his path toward a single goal: completing the grand design he began in his previous life and laying the foundation for true godhood.

show.name: Thirty-Six Stratagems: Slay
show.summary: When the Strait Command Tower is hit, Yan Zizhou, also known as Night Blade, is assigned to investigate, only for his sister Xiaoxiao to suddenly plunge from a building. Using the Thirty-Six Stratagems, he joins forces with his second brother Zong Xiaoquan, and Li Li, Xiaoxiao's separated twin sister, to help local police reveal, through Li Luo, the case of their parents' murder eighteen years earlier and bring He Huan and her sibling, Kang Qingtian, and the other chief culprits to justice.

They rediscover themselves in each other's identities and find their own path to change amidst the misalignment.

show.name: Love Island Australia
show.summary:
Taking the hottest international reality show format right now and unleashing it on 9GO!, the multi-million-dollar stripped format commission, Love Island Australia, will see sexy young Aussie singles on the lookout for romance, jetting off to a summer paradise to find love in the sun in Spain.

Not only must they must choose their partner wisely and stay the course as sexy new singles enter the island, but they also must win the hearts of the public, convincing them – and themselves – that their newfound love is real.

Throughout weeks of dates, challenges, eliminations and sexy new singles, all in front of our eyes, viewers will get to decide who they want to stay, who they want to boot, and ultimately who they want to crown the hottest couple on Love Island Australia. The winning couple are handed a pot of money to start their new lives together, but there's a catch: one is given the chance to share the money or walk away with it all for them self. Were they after love or money all along?

show.name: When I Meet the Moon
show.summary: The socially anxious Yun Li applies for a postgraduate program in Nanwu to prove her independence to her father. A day before the semester begins, she is invited to a local virtual reality (VR) center as a video creator. There, she reunites with Fu Shize, the genius and her high school crush. She gradually opens up, and, with the help of others, goes all out to court her dream man, winning him over with her warmth and radiance. However, amid the loving moments, their differing perspectives eventually lead to a breakup. When she goes abroad, his deeply suppressed trauma is brought to the forefront. To win her back, he gets back on his feet, leading his team to new heights in scientific research. When she returns to China, he pursues her relentlessly, and the two overcome their differences and rekindle their love.

show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

show.name: The Silent Storm
show.summary: In 1994, tax auditor Ouyang Xu, criminal investigator Yan Ping'an, and Zhou Haiyang—who was searching for his missing wife—met through a counterfeit invoice case in Chunjiang City. Under the tide of the times, the three experienced vastly different circumstances, and their fates gradually diverged. Years later, Operation Grain Rain brings them together again—but the brothers of old now stand on opposite sides. Ouyang Xu faces off against the tax fraud ring led by Zhou Haiyang and the protective umbrella behind it, caught in a painful choice between emotion and the law. Starting from a single invoice, he tears away the veil of greed and ultimately eliminates evil, safeguarding justice.

show.name: WWE Monday Night RAW
show.summary: WWE Monday Night RAW is World Wrestling Entertainment's (formerly the WWF and the WWWF before that) premiere wrestling event and brand. Since its launch in 1993, WWE Monday Night RAW continues to air live on Monday nights. It is generally seen as the company's flagship program due to its prolific history, high ratings, weekly live format, and emphasis on pay-per-views. Monday Night RAW is high profile enough to attract frequent visits from celebrities who usually serve as guest hosts for a single live event. Since its first episode, the show has been broadcast live or recorded from more than 197 different arenas in 165 cities and towns in seven different nations: including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom twice a year, Afghanistan for a special Tribute to the Troops, Germany, Japan, Italy and Mexico.

show.name: The Great Long March
show.summary: Revolving around the arduous Long March of the Central Red Army, it documents the historical process—from the army's failure in the fifth counter-encirclement campaign, to the First, Second, Fourth Front Armies of the Red Army and the 25th Red Army launching strategic transfers under the leadership of the CPC Central Committee—to eventual triumph. It extols the unyielding ideals and revolutionary spirit of Mao Zedong and Chinese Communists, and elucidates the history and logic behind the rise and development of the Chinese revolution, proving that adapting Marxism to China's specific conditions was essential for victory.

show.summary: As markets open and the day's biggest stories take shape, anchor Christine Romans will translate breaking developments, politics, global news and the economy to help viewers stay informed and understand what's next. The two-hour program will also feature segments on finance, business, technology, AI and other consequential topics, leveraging Romans' role as NBC News' chief business correspondent.

show.name: Murdoch Mysteries
show.summary: Set in Toronto at the dawn of the 20th century, Murdoch Mysteries is a one-hour drama series that explores the intriguing world of William Murdoch, a methodical and dashing detective who pioneers innovative forensic techniques to solve some of the city's most gruesome murders. Murdoch's colleagues include the love of his life, coroner and psychiatrist Dr. Julia Ogden, a staunch ally who shares the detective's fascination for science; Constable George Crabtree, Murdoch's eager but sometimes naïve right-hand man; Inspector Brackenreid, Murdoch's skeptical yet reluctantly supportive boss; and coroner Dr. Emily Grace, Dr. Ogden's protégé.

show.name: Days of Our Lives
show.summary:
Days of our Lives is set in the fictitious Midwestern town of Salem. The core families are the Bradys, the Hortons and the DiMeras, and the multi-layered storylines involve elements of romance, adventure, mystery, comedy and drama.

Beginning on September 12, 2022, DAYS became exclusive to streaming on Peacock.

show.summary:
The reality competition, hosted by Parker Posey, follows a group of celebrities in a lavish Italian villa as they shake down, hustle, and whack their way to win up to $250,000.

Every episode, they will tackle mob movie-inspired jobs to survive. But every mob family needs a don, and whoever they choose will have absolute power — deciding who makes money, who stays, and who ultimately gets whacked.

body.name: Washington Wizards at Detroit Pistons
body.summary:
Two-time NBA All-Star Cade Cunningham and the Detroit Pistons (6-2) host 10-time NBA All-Star Anthony Davis and the Washington Wizards (4-4) from Little Caesars Arena in Detroit, Mich.

Led by Cunningham's All-Star-caliber play, the Pistons sit in second place in the Eastern Conference and have beaten top teams in the conference, including Boston and Philadelphia. The Wizards feature the All-Star duo of Davis and Trae Young in their first seasons in Washington, the latter of whom leads the NBA in assists. The up-and-coming team also features 2026 No. 1 overall pick AJ Dybantsa, who had 21 points in the Wizards' win over the Magic on Monday.
